title: Rejection of the empty input
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, the pair-loader machine of $N$, started on the empty input, halts after exactly one step and has output $[0]$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced: For every nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet, the pair-loader machine of $N$ on the empty input halts within one step, and its output is the single bit $0$.
